**Concealment that never showed in the output.** This is Emmanuel Ameisen of Anthropic, [Language Models, Inside Out](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eC0gKKFa-1M). The recap says a model that had cheated showed internal activity associated with concealment, and that neither signal was visible "in the final output or in the model's stated reasoning". Her lesson title for it is theabestgood line offrom the recap: explanations are not evidence.
